task.title: Build, launch and validate a fresh portable artifact from current main
task.objective: Produce a portable SpecterStudio artifact generated from the exact current main HEAD, prove its freshness with source-to-artifact evidence, launch that exact artifact, and determine definitively whether previously observed old renderer UI is caused by a stale artifact or by genuine defects in a genuinely fresh artifact.

preserved_notes: The gitignored developer launcher /run-app-demo.mjs and any untracked owner material must be preserved untouched.
Stale dist/ artifacts are generated build output. They may be labelled and superseded, but no user-authored file may be deleted.

writer.note: Final project-state reconciliation after the exact roadmap pin commit 2678add. This writer records the final gate outputs and Sources agree result in the newest CURRENT_STATE, HANDOFF and TASK_LOG sections, updates the task contract's measured evidence, and prepares completion without changing product, release, verifier or Beads content. EV-push remains pending until git push origin main actually succeeds.

architecture: Use the repository-authoritative packaging pipeline scripts/package-portable.ps1 via npm run package:portable; do not hand-invoke electron-builder to bypass a failing gate.
Do not reuse an older package after a failed packaging attempt.
security: Do not alter signing-key custody, and do not set the synced-key override; the approved non-synced key location must be used as-is.
Do not weaken manifest, provenance, fresh-state or strict-offline gates to make packaging succeed.
compatibility: Windows PowerShell 5.1 remains the packaging host shell and no administrator rights may be required.
offline: No internet dependency, telemetry, runtime download, global Node, global Playwright or global browser may be introduced.
Any commit SHA embedded for provenance must be build-time metadata only, never a network call.

acceptance.description: The application builds from the exact baseline commit with a clean typecheck.

A portable artifact is newly generated from baseline commit 9778437 and its provenance record names that exact commit, a build timestamp from this task, and a SHA-256 differing from the superseded 0.1.29 artifact.
Strict offline validation passes against the manifest regenerated at the baseline commit.

The renderer surfaces are validated from the freshly generated artifact, and each surface is reported as NEW DESIGN CONFIRMED, PARTIAL, DEFECT FOUND, NOT RUN or BLOCKED without inference from any older executable.
Authoritative roadmap sources remain consistent and the Overview banner reads Sources agree.

evidence.note: Ran three times under the release lease, clean on every run: tsc --noEmit passed, 2142 modules transformed, the sole warning is the pre-existing securityKernel.ts chunking advisory, and each run reported 'Embedded roadmap snapshot: 445 records from 14 sources.' Every run re-emitted the identical content-hashed bundles renderer-DHTPf3g5.js and renderer-C710MO4w.css, which under Vite content hashing proves the out/ tree was already current for this source rather than proving it was skipped. Final project-state rerun after the two follow-up Beads also passed with 268 main and 2142 renderer modules and an updated embedded snapshot of 447 records from 14 sources; the same advisory and renderer content hashes remained.

PASS 119/119 on the fresh 0.1.29 package after the qa extension (previous suite 87/87; +32 non-vacuous provenance checks). The verifier used createRequire(import.meta.url) with @electron/asar listPackage/extractFile and Windows join()-constructed member paths. It extracted the real /out/main/main.js and found validation:statusAll; extracted packaged /out/renderer/index.html and measured SHA-256 2d3e59e3a20c563964a54ead4491ca971ae7e0c9ff4b8dd0cf87bee7e376e196, byte-identical to current built out/renderer/index.html; required positive JS and CSS reference cardinality; rejected remote HTTP(S), /@vite/ and non-./assets entry resources; and proved exact three-file set and byte parity across packaged/built renderer assets (renderer-DHTPf3g5.js, renderer-C710MO4w.css, specter-logo-CZ9s2PgP.svg), so neither orphan nor mismatched assets exist. Source global.css measured 175 --awkit-* definitions / 109 unique token names, all present in both referenced built and packaged CSS. release-provenance.json version 0.1.29, portable path, size 236681017, SHA-256 c891b1b5171202b914153dd7d35ed60b50ba6fea93ab5f5c2132a84a8bd224dd and treeDirty false all matched the actual artifact; source commit 13eb9ebf13a14cff12854eb3586ca64617da0a58 exists and was an ancestor of current HEAD. The real packaged app also launched, rendered, and completed the pre-existing validation, migration, authorization, persistence, expiry, shutdown and offline checks.

Final post-project-state result PASS 177/177 with the Overview banner reading 'Sources agree'. Filing awkit-vpje and awkit-befd first produced the expected 175/177 failure only at the old exact pins (277 versus measured 279, and 2 outstanding / 275 closed versus measured 4 / 275). completion.note: COMPLETE 2026-09-10. Outcome A is established: stale artifacts caused the observed old UI. QA PASS includes EV-ui-provenance at 119/119, and the 24-verifier GUI battery of roughly 1300 checks found zero current renderer defects. The fresh 0.1.29 portable is bound to clean source 13eb9eb, the packaged renderer entry and every referenced/packaged renderer asset are byte-bound to the fresh build, all Hologram token names propagate, and the real packaged app launched and rendered.
